subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept a native folder-backed encrypted snapshot and workspace-mirroring backup flow with new backup config once the safety and proof blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a new core backup mode, persistent config keys, and restore behavior over state/config/OAuth/workspaces, so product and security ownership should confirm this belongs in core rather than remaining external before merge.

options.title: Keep as core candidate after repair
options.body: Treat this as a plausible core backup direction, but require the safety fixes, clean rebase, owner/security review, and real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to archive/restore hardening
options.body: Ask the contributor to split out only the safest improvements to the existing backup create/verify/archive path and leave folder snapshots for later.

options.title: Move snapshot workflow outside core
options.body: Close or redirect the folder-backed snapshot workflow to an external plugin or ClawHub-style package if maintainers do not want this config surface in core.

recommendation.title: Keep as core candidate after repair
recommendation.body: Treat this as a plausible core backup direction, but require the safety fixes, clean rebase, owner/security review, and real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merge/co-author history on backup security and broad repository ownership make this the best available decision owner signal.
